description.value: Angelina's Dutch Corner is a family-owned restaurant at the New Westminster Quay waterfront, serving authentic Dutch-inspired breakfast and lunch in a warm, kid-friendly setting with scenic river views. It has been a community institution for over two decades — a decade under current owner Eric Missouri — and prides itself on locally and responsibly sourced ingredients. The quayside pedestrian-zone patio and welcoming atmosphere make it a natural rest stop on any Lower Mainland cycling route.
